title: Korea Vlog: Shipping from Seoul to Manila, Korean Clothing Shopping and No Brand Burger!
description:
Hi! Your Mommy finally tried Korean Spa for the first time...and. this definitely won't be the last! It's an absolute pampering, I feel renewed! Something I look forward to when I back to Seoul! And we tried first too, mag-pa-ship from Seoul to Manila via EMS and it worked but I a little pricey and your Mommy went shopping again and it was not planned..yung napadaan ka lang to check...window shopping talaga lang ang plan ko pero and daming maganda...nabudol ang Mommy nyo! We tried first time no brand burger, well, not a burger personbut not bad..and it's cheap..and your Mommy's first time to eat Jajangmyeona and Tangsuyuk, I like it! These two are ultimate Korean-Chinese comfort food and usually being eaten on moving day, a famous South Korean tradition.
